scenarios.source: spec/engines/website/SPEC-website-engine.md §Target Website API: системная модель; tests/ACCEPTANCE-MATRIX.md Website criterion: системный DTO по group grant
preconditions: Одна логическая система без дополнительных уровней изоляции.
У credential есть либо отсутствует прямой Website read grant.
scenarios.input: Запрос системной модели ContentModel через Website application contract от credential с read grant и без него.
scenarios.action: Вызвать operation чтения системной модели Website с проверкой group grant.
scenarios.expected_result: Read grant получает стабильный системный ContentModel; отсутствие grant получает typed forbidden result.
scenarios.expected_state: Операция не создаёт Website records и не раскрывает данные за пределами grants.

scenarios.source: spec/engines/website/SPEC-website-engine.md §Target Website API: страницы и их версии, paragraph 2; SPEC-site-editor-workspace.md §Target: dynamic pages and template library, paragraph 1
preconditions: В единственной логической системе есть Website write grant.
Новая страница ещё не имеет page identity.
scenarios.input: Create-page request без template и с Idempotency-Key; повтор того же request; caller-supplied page identity там, где контракт её не принимает.
scenarios.action: Создать страницу через Website application contract.
scenarios.expected_result: Server generates stable UUID, synchronously returns exactly one ready root snapshot, and idempotent replay returns the same result; caller cannot select or reuse page identity.
scenarios.expected_state: Failure leaves no partially visible page or root snapshot and does not create a Router route.

scenarios.source: spec/engines/website/SPEC-website-engine.md §Target Website API: страницы и их версии, paragraphs 1 and 3; SPEC-branches-snapshots.md §Проверяемые требования, items 1-2
preconditions: В системе существуют две страницы с root snapshots.
Parent snapshot готов и принадлежит первой странице.
scenarios.input: Create-child snapshot requests for the owner page, another page, an unknown page, a foreign namespace/scope, and a direct root request.
scenarios.action: Создать immutable snapshot child через Website.
scenarios.expected_result: Only a child of the exact existing page_id ready parent in that page tree is accepted; root creation outside page creation, cross-tree parents and foreign-scope parents are rejected.
scenarios.expected_state: Каждое page tree остаётся независимым; rejected request не меняет sequence, parent или snapshot state.

scenarios.source: spec/engines/website/SPEC-website-engine.md §Target Website API: страницы и их версии, paragraph 3
preconditions: Есть ready parent snapshot с известной revision и дочернее structural state.
scenarios.input: Structural save/fork с актуальной и stale expected revision, включая concurrent change.
scenarios.action: Сохранить structural change и попытаться повторить stale request.
scenarios.expected_result: Актуальная операция создаёт child; stale revision yields controlled conflict without overwrite; parent remains immutable.
scenarios.expected_state: Rejected conflict не создаёт partial snapshot и не меняет Content values, publication или Router target.

scenarios.source: spec/engines/website/SPEC-website-engine.md §Target Website API: страницы и их версии, paragraphs 4-6; SPEC-data-model.md §§Product decisions, Persistence and runtime
preconditions: В системе есть revisioned системная модель и snapshots нескольких страниц.
scenarios.input: Model PUT с expected revision, stale revision и binding, который становится incompatible; content-projection requests с exact и несовпадающими page/snapshot tuple.
scenarios.action: Сохранить системную модель и прочитать typed model/projection DTOs.
scenarios.expected_result: Model is system-scoped CAS state; invalidating change is rejected; projection is returned only for the exact (page_id, snapshot_id) tuple.
scenarios.expected_state: Model revision не хранится в snapshot namespace; rejected mutation leaves model and bindings unchanged.

scenarios.source: spec/engines/website/SPEC-site-editor-workspace.md §§Ownership, Model and placement editing, Acceptance criteria items 3-4; SPEC-data-model.md §Feature data contract and bindings
preconditions: Snapshot pins a manifest-conformant feature build and the system model contains direct fields.
scenarios.input: Configure scalar, record and collection dataInputs plus valid/invalid arguments, unknown fields, relationIds and incompatible ports.
scenarios.action: Save structural placement bindings from /site.
scenarios.expected_result: Only direct typed bindings compatible with the pinned manifest are accepted; relation traversal and unknown/invalid bindings are rejected.
scenarios.expected_state: Rejected save creates no partial structural snapshot; editorial values and selections remain owned by /content.

scenarios.source: spec/engines/website/SPEC-data-model.md §Model structure, paragraphs 3-5; SPEC-site-editor-workspace.md §Record editing and publication, paragraphs 1-2
preconditions: A locale-scoped content workspace exists for a model with drafts and publication state.
scenarios.input: Create a singleton, clear its record, publish explicitly, and attempt many-to-singleton change with more than one draft or published record.
scenarios.action: Apply data-model cardinality operations through the authoritative contract.
scenarios.expected_result: New singleton gets exactly one empty draft, never auto-publishes, clear preserves record ID, and lossy cardinality change is rejected.
scenarios.expected_state: Rejected change preserves existing records, draft/publication revisions and locale isolation.

scenarios.source: spec/engines/website/SPEC-website-engine.md §Библиотека шаблонов страниц, paragraphs 2-5; SPEC-site-editor-workspace.md §Target: dynamic pages and template library, paragraphs 2-3
preconditions: System-scoped template exists with a known revision, digest and valid feature lock.
scenarios.input: Create/update/delete template with current and stale expected revision; create page from exact template revision; use an unknown or foreign-namespace template ID.
scenarios.action: Perform template-library operations and page materialization.
scenarios.expected_result: Template is system-scoped CAS state; create pins and materializes the exact revision; stale, unknown or foreign-namespace template is refused with a machine-readable error.
scenarios.expected_state: Template edits/deletion do not mutate already materialized pages or their snapshots; rejected calls create no page/snapshot.

scenarios.source: spec/engines/website/SPEC-website-engine.md §Библиотека шаблонов страниц, paragraphs 6-9; SPEC-site-editor-workspace.md §Target: dynamic pages and template library, paragraphs 3-4
preconditions: Existing page has a ready snapshot, Router binding and Content values; a newer valid template revision exists.
scenarios.input: Apply template with/without confirmation, correct/stale page and template revision, and a concurrent incompatible change.
scenarios.action: Run explicit structural replacement.
scenarios.expected_result: Confirmed operation creates a child in the same page tree and replaces only declared structure; unconfirmed/stale/invalid operation conflicts without partial state.
scenarios.expected_state: Parent, page ID, other trees, Router binding, system model and Content values remain unchanged; only old-placement selections reset in the new child.

scenarios.source: spec/engines/website/SPEC-website-engine.md §§Target Website API: страницы и их версии, Страничные snapshots и сборка; SPEC-branches-snapshots.md §§Границы, Публичная выдача
preconditions: A Website snapshot and a Router route target have independent configured identities.
scenarios.input: Create/save a snapshot payload containing route, URL, branch assignment or system-wide record data; separately inspect accepted snapshot/build DTOs.
scenarios.action: Validate Website structural input and build result boundaries.
scenarios.expected_result: Website accepts no route/URL/branch assignment or record values in snapshot input and does not activate Router targets itself.
scenarios.expected_state: Structural mutation preserves prior public artifact; Router selection remains an explicit outer orchestration/CAS action.

scenarios.source: spec/engines/website/SPEC-website-engine.md §§Контракт feature ZIP, Проверка ZIP и отказоустойчивость; SPEC-feature-runtime.md §§Целевой ABI, Проверяемые требования items 1 and 5
preconditions: A ZIP validator receives untrusted feature package bytes under configured limits.
scenarios.input: Malformed ZIP, traversal including Windows paths, symlink, normalized duplicate path, archive bomb/oversized entry, invalid manifest and unsupported ABI.
scenarios.action: Run feature-import preflight before any output file creation.
scenarios.expected_result: Each unsafe or invalid package is rejected deterministically before a version becomes ready; only static-lifecycle with declared files is accepted.
scenarios.expected_state: No partial feature catalog record, FileSet membership or extracted file is visible after rejection.

scenarios.source: spec/engines/website/SPEC-website-engine.md §§Импорт фичи из файла, Состояния и повтор, Проверка ZIP и отказоустойчивость; tests/ACCEPTANCE-MATRIX.md Website criterion: feature ZIP preflight/import/recovery
preconditions: A dedicated disposable PostgreSQL database and object-storage bucket are configured for this run.
A Core capability test fixture can create, read and delete only run-owned files and module-data records.
scenarios.input: Import an authorized source_file_id, replay same/different idempotency fingerprint, simulate crash after each Core operation and source-cleanup failure.
scenarios.action: Run the durable feature import workflow against disposable Core storage.
scenarios.expected_result: Same fingerprint resumes or returns one job, conflicting fingerprint is rejected, and recovery preserves exact progress without duplicate outputs.
scenarios.expected_state: Feature version becomes ready only after verified outputs and source cleanup; failures expose no partial ready version.

scenarios.source: spec/engines/website/SPEC-website-engine.md §§Зависимости и tokens, Страничные snapshots и сборка; SPEC-feature-runtime.md §Целевой ABI, paragraphs 5-6
preconditions: Catalog contains exact feature versions with manifests and declared public APIs.
scenarios.input: Resolve compatible and incompatible SemVer ranges, dependency cycle, ambiguous candidates and changed imported dependency after snapshot lock.
scenarios.action: Create/validate a snapshot dependency lock and build digest.
scenarios.expected_result: Resolver has one deterministic compatible closure or rejects the request; lock retains exact versions, hashes and API versions.
scenarios.expected_state: A later import does not alter an existing snapshot or its build digest; invalid closure creates no ready snapshot.

scenarios.source: spec/engines/website/SPEC-static-site-artifact.md §§2. Manifest schema, 3. Правила путей и содержимого, 4. Построение, проверка и жизненный цикл; SPEC-website-engine.md §Prerender, paragraphs 1-3; tests/ACCEPTANCE-MATRIX.md Website criterion: deterministic artifact validation
preconditions: A Website build produces a candidate static-page-artifact/v1 manifest and immutable files.
scenarios.input: Valid artifact plus invalid/missing document metadata, unknown/missing asset, illegal asset path and MIME mismatch.
scenarios.action: Validate artifact before it is returned for trusted Router activation.
scenarios.expected_result: Only a complete deterministic one-page artifact with valid document and assets is accepted; visitor-selected identifiers never participate.
scenarios.expected_state: Rejected artifact is not made active and leaves the prior Router target untouched.

scenarios.source: spec/engines/website/features/SPEC-feature-runtime.md §§Целевой ABI, Проверяемые требования items 2-3; SPEC-public-server-rendering.md §§HTML template, escaping и DOM, Prerender worker, Acceptance criteria; SPEC-seo.md §§Metadata и индексация, Sitemap и detail metadata, Acceptance criteria; SPEC-system-pages.md §§Core response contract, Acceptance criteria
preconditions: A page uses valid static-lifecycle features and locale-specific trusted projections.
scenarios.input: Render initial markup, hydrate it, isolate a placement error, render locale SEO/system pages, and exercise empty/missing optional data.
scenarios.action: Run the server-rendering and runtime contract checks.
scenarios.expected_result: Hydration preserves server markup, each placement has one lifecycle root, and output supplies only the declared locale-specific SEO/system-page behavior.
scenarios.expected_state: No secret/private context enters public HTML; one placement failure does not corrupt sibling output or activate a partial artifact.

scenarios.source: spec/engines/website/features/SPEC-feature-runtime.md §§Целевой ABI, Media declarations, Проверяемые требования items 3 and 5; SPEC-design-tokens.md §§Публичная выдача CSS, Сравнение с родительским снапшотом, API и публичная тема
preconditions: Pinned manifest declares lifecycle, public APIs, exact HTTPS origins and feature-owned token schema.
scenarios.input: Concurrent update/cancellation/dispose; wildcard or undeclared origin; invalid response; credentials in context; invalid or incomplete light/dark token values.
scenarios.action: Validate feature runtime context, network policy and graphical design token state.
scenarios.expected_result: Runtime uses only declared HTTPS origins and typed contracts, propagates cancellation, excludes credentials, and accepts only complete accessible token values.
scenarios.expected_state: Cancelled work cannot mutate DOM; invalid request/token state is rejected without partial saved design change or broader CSP/CORS permission.

scenarios.source: spec/engines/website/SPEC-website-engine.md §§Target Website API: страницы и их версии, Безопасность и проверяемые инварианты; tests/ACCEPTANCE-MATRIX.md HTTP Presentation and Website criteria
preconditions: Admin Website HTTP adapter and its OpenAPI contract are mounted in a test composition.
scenarios.input: Valid and invalid page/snapshot/template requests against flat /api/admin/... paths, missing revision/idempotency headers, unsupported body fields, unauthorized group levels and route fields in Website DTOs.
scenarios.action: Exercise mounted unversioned /api/... Website handlers and compare their OpenAPI schemas.
scenarios.expected_result: Routes are flat unversioned /api paths with strict bounded decode, typed errors, required headers and group checks; request/response schema excludes Router assignment fields and extra scope identifiers.
scenarios.expected_state: Invalid/unauthorized HTTP request produces no structural mutation and no existence disclosure for foreign resources.

scenarios.source: spec/engines/website/SPEC-website-engine.md §§Данные Website, Безопасность и проверяемые инварианты, Приёмочные проверки items 10-11; tests/ACCEPTANCE-MATRIX.md Website criterion: typed trusted projections
preconditions: A dedicated disposable PostgreSQL database and object-storage bucket are configured for this run.
Website uses only Core presentation capabilities under its scoped module identity.
scenarios.input: Seed a page and root snapshot through the scoped Core module-data capability on disposable PostgreSQL; race stale CAS; revoke a Core session; probe foreign namespace and undeclared scope.
scenarios.action: Run persistence and boundary scenarios against disposable Core with the Website read path and explicit S3 private-contract fixture.
scenarios.expected_result: Website reads the seeded records, stale CAS fails without a revision bump, revocation fails closed, and foreign namespace/scope operations are rejected.
scenarios.expected_state: No cross-namespace/scope record or partial artifact becomes observable after failed persistence operations.

scenarios.source: spec/engines/website/SPEC-website-engine.md §§Декларативные media-профили и производные файлы, Приёмочные проверки item 9; SPEC-feature-runtime.md §Media declarations
preconditions: A disposable Core file store, PostgreSQL, S3, and a Docker/Linux kernel-enforced media sandbox are configured with explicit resource limits.
scenarios.input: Invalid source/profile, client profile override, MIME/size/checksum failure, cancellation/retry/restart, profile or processor-version change, and a fresh source under the same caller key.
scenarios.action: Launch the manifest-pinned media derivative workflow in the disposable stack and probe sandbox isolation from inside the container.
scenarios.expected_result: Website accepts only the pinned x-media profile and updates the field only after all outputs validate; retry identity includes source checksum/profile/processor; network and cgroup limits are enforced by the kernel.
scenarios.expected_state: Original and prior field value survive failure/cancellation/restart; derivatives are immutable, inherit groups/FileSets and partial outputs are not ready.

scenarios.source: spec/engines/website/SPEC-website-engine.md §§Страничные snapshots и сборка, Prerender, Приёмочные проверки items 7-8; SPEC-feature-runtime.md paragraphs 46-48
preconditions: A disposable worker.prerender sandbox, Core artifact store and explicit network policy fixture are configured.
scenarios.input: render-plan/v2 with changed locale/catalog/content revision, invalid plan, duplicate keys, digest mismatch, loopback/private/link-local/metadata request, timeout/cancellation/restart and stale result.
scenarios.action: Run locale-bound prerender and artifact verification workflow in a kernel-enforced disposable Docker/Linux sandbox with real headless Chromium.
scenarios.expected_result: Build identity contains trusted revisions/digests; sandbox rejects forbidden network and stale result; only verified artifact is ready for outer orchestration.
scenarios.expected_state: Prior active artifact survives failure; worker writes only through Core and no partial artifact is activated.

scenarios.source: spec/engines/website/SPEC-website-engine.md §Страничные snapshots и сборка, paragraphs 4-5; SPEC-branches-snapshots.md §Публичная выдача, paragraphs 2-3; tests/ACCEPTANCE-MATRIX.md Website criterion: rebuild fan-out/retry/stale-result protection
preconditions: Disposable Website, Content projection and Router target-CAS capabilities are connected through trusted outer orchestration.
scenarios.input: Publish changed model/content locale across several affected route/locale targets, fail one build/CAS, retry, then advance input revision before old result activates.
scenarios.action: Run durable rebuild fan-out and per-target activation.
scenarios.expected_result: Every (route, locale) target uses independent CAS; successes remain, failed target retains prior artifact, retry is safe, and stale output is discarded.
scenarios.expected_state: Website never selects visitor target or performs direct Router call; partial failure has no rollback of independent successful targets.

scenarios.source: spec/engines/website/SPEC-website-engine.md §Target Website API: страницы и их версии, paragraph 2; tests/ACCEPTANCE-MATRIX.md Page retirement criterion
preconditions: Disposable page has registered Router route targets, snapshots, Content history, Forms resources and Core files.
scenarios.input: Start retirement with If-Match and Idempotency-Key, fail one withdrawal, retry and attempt page-ID reuse.
scenarios.action: Run the durable retirement workflow through trusted orchestration.
scenarios.expected_result: Each route target is withdrawn independently; page becomes retired only after all complete; retry is idempotent and reused page ID is refused.
scenarios.expected_state: Snapshots/page identity, Content drafts/history, Forms resources and Core files remain; only separate checked cleanup may delete files.

scenarios.source: spec/engines/website/features/SPEC-feature-runtime.md §§Целевой ABI, Проверяемые требования item 1
preconditions: Runtime receives an untrusted format-2 manifest and the verified archive file set.
scenarios.input: Accepted name static-lifecycle, retired static-lifecycle-v2, duplicate/unknown keys, secret-like arguments, missing assets, wildcard/private origins and invalid field types.
scenarios.action: Parse and validate the manifest against the pinned ABI.
scenarios.expected_result: Only static-lifecycle with complete declared local assets and exact HTTPS origins is accepted; every other input is rejected with a typed error.
scenarios.expected_state: No manifest is published and no secret-like key reaches the public feature contract.

scenarios.source: spec/engines/website/features/SPEC-feature-runtime.md §60; spec/engines/website/SPEC-website-engine.md §Контракт feature ZIP; spec/workers/SPEC-workers.md §Archive isolation
preconditions: A ZIP preflight receives untrusted package bytes under configured bounds.
scenarios.input: Malformed ZIP, traversal including Windows separators, symlink, duplicate normalized path, oversized/expanding entry, missing manifest and retired ABI.
scenarios.action: Run runtime preflight before constructing any output.
scenarios.expected_result: Unsafe or invalid packages are rejected deterministically and a valid package yields sorted verified files plus its manifest.
scenarios.expected_state: Preflight is pure: a rejected package returns no files, manifest or partial output.

scenarios.source: spec/engines/website/features/SPEC-feature-runtime.md §§Целевой ABI, dependency lock paragraph; Проверяемые требования item 4
preconditions: A catalog contains exact feature versions with digests and public API versions.
scenarios.input: Compatible and incompatible SemVer ranges, dependency cycle, conflicting providers, changed imported digest and an already locked compatible version.
scenarios.action: Resolve and validate an immutable dependency lock.
scenarios.expected_result: One deterministic compatible closure is returned with exact version/digest/API version or the request fails closed.
scenarios.expected_state: A later import cannot silently alter an existing lock; an invalid closure produces no ready snapshot.

scenarios.source: spec/engines/website/SPEC-static-site-artifact.md §§2-4
preconditions: A candidate static-page-artifact/v1 manifest and trusted Core file metadata are available.
scenarios.input: Valid artifact plus missing document metadata, wrong document MIME, missing asset, illegal asset path, nested HTML asset, unknown cache class and tampered digest.
scenarios.action: Validate the artifact manifest and compare it with trusted Core metadata.
scenarios.expected_result: Only a complete deterministic single-document artifact with canonical paths, allowed content types and matching checksums is accepted.
scenarios.expected_state: A rejected or mismatched artifact never becomes active and the prior target artifact is unchanged.

scenarios.source: spec/engines/website/features/SPEC-feature-runtime.md §§Целевой ABI, paragraphs 2-4; Проверяемые требования items 2-3
preconditions: A pinned static-lifecycle feature receives a trusted page projection and a scoped signal.
scenarios.input: render, hydrate, update and dispose on one placement, a secret-like context, and a failing sibling placement.
scenarios.action: Run the lifecycle state machine and build the public context.
scenarios.expected_result: Lifecycle phases run in order with the newest update context; credentials are rejected; one placement failure does not block siblings.
scenarios.expected_state: No secret enters the public context and cancelled work cannot mutate another placement.

scenarios.source: spec/engines/website/features/SPEC-feature-runtime.md §§Целевой ABI, publication paragraph; Проверяемые требования item 6; spec/engines/router/SPEC-router-engine.md §Publication
preconditions: Several registered route/locale targets exist behind a trusted CAS activator.
scenarios.input: Stale input digest, different locale, a failed CAS on one target and a retry of only that target.
scenarios.action: Run independent per-target activation and retry failed targets.
scenarios.expected_result: Each target keeps its own revision and artifact; successes are not rolled back and only failed targets are retried.
scenarios.expected_state: A stale or failed target retains its previous artifact and no visitor-selected target is used.

scenarios.source: spec/engines/website/features/SPEC-feature-runtime.md §§Целевой ABI, executor paragraphs; Проверяемые требования item 5; spec/workers/SPEC-workers.md §Isolation
preconditions: A supervised external process is configured by static composition and the browser host source is embedded.
scenarios.input: Relative binary path, embedded control characters, unbounded output limit, missing process and embedded host missing a lifecycle guarantee.
scenarios.action: Validate executor configuration and static host invariants, then attempt a lifecycle call.
scenarios.expected_result: Invalid configuration, missing process and incomplete embedded host fail closed with typed errors.
scenarios.expected_state: No malformed envelope reaches feature code and no lifecycle guarantee is silently absent.
